title: Not soft, but very attractive...
text: Not soft, but very attractive.... This is a very atttractive throw - but not terribly soft.  It’s completely woven, and looks much more expensive than the asking price.  I immediately thought of all the uses - it could be a tablecloth - a throw on a couch or bed - carry it in the car for seat coverage, etc.  It’s not a throw you are inspired to cuddle up with because of the lack of softness.  But, it is very good quality.
